meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器:检查文件或目录的诊断,按行列定位符号定义,搜索工作区引用与符号,并检查、执行重命名。
howto.when: 当你需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等能力,或要为重命名做安全检查时触发;若诊断提示缺少语言服务器,先用 lsp.status 查看。

say.text: 对 src/index.ts 跑一下 lsp 诊断,只看 error
say.note: 返回该文件的诊断结果并过滤为错误级

say.text: 用 lsp.status 看看有哪些语言服务器
say.note: 列出已配置、已安装、缺失、禁用的服务器

say.text: 把 foo 这个符号重命名,先检查是否合法
say.note: 先 prepare_rename 校验,再应用工作区编辑

howto.what_en: It lets Claude call language servers through lsp tools: check diagnostics for a file or directory, jump to a symbol definition by line and character, search workspace references and symbols, and prepare or apply renames.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need language-server diagnostics, definitions, references or similar, or a rename safety check; run lsp.status first if a diagnostic reports a missing language server.

say_en.text: Run lsp diagnostics on src/index.ts, errors only
say_en.note: Returns that file's diagnostics filtered to errors

say_en.text: Run lsp.status to see the language servers
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed, missing and disabled servers

say_en.text: Rename the symbol foo, check validity first
say_en.note: prepare_rename runs first, then the rename edit is applied
